column1: # org-postgres-suite.tsv - the ONE copy of the org PostgreSQL suite's package
# list and live-PG rule. Read by scripts/ci/org-postgres-suite.sh (CI) and by
# tools/testrunner (its @pg units); neither keeps a list of its own.
# Columns are tab separated; '#' lines and blank lines are ignored.
#   derive  <regexp>  <roots, space separated>
#       Every directory under a root holding a _test.go file with a line
#       matching <regexp> is in the suite. The row may repeat: the suite is
#       the union of the rows, and each row must derive at least one
#       package (a row deriving none has drifted, and both readers fail).
#       The regexp is read by grep as a basic regexp and by Go's regexp
#       package; keep it to the syntax both read the same way (no
#       alternation: GNU grep's \| is not Go's, so a second pattern is a
#       second row).
#       The rows: the two-writer / concurrency suites (plan acceptance
#       criterion 9), then every package whose tests open a PostgreSQL
#       fixture. Since dbtest.New opens PostgreSQL by default (D-24) and
#       fails without OBSERVER_CONTROL_STORE_DSN, such a package can only
#       run with a database, so it is in the suite: dbtest.New,
#       dbtest.NewPostgres and dbtest.NewPostgresDSN (New[(P]),
#       dbtest.ForEachEngine, and controltest's postgres dialect
#       (controltest.Dialects, controltest.Postgres). The SQLite-only
#       fixtures (dbtest.NewSQLite, NewAt, NewAtFresh, Open with a file
#       path, controltest.Open(t, controltest.SQLite)) match no row, so
#       their packages stay plain units (cmd/observer and tests/invariant
#       among them).
#   package <pattern>
#       A fixed package or ./dir/... pattern (the migration lineages and
#       dbtest, the advisory-lock leader, the live control-store dialect
#       suite, the ingest apply/receipt path, the org CLI's live-PG tests,
#       and the packages whose ForEachEngine "postgres" subtests declare no
#       TwoWriters test, D-712 and T-861).
#   live    <extended regexp>
#       A test (or subtest) whose name matches is a live-PG test: in this
#       suite it must run, so a skip of one is a failure, and a suite in
#       which none ran fails too. "/postgres" is the ForEachEngine and
#       controltest.Dialects subtest, LivePG the TestLivePG* tests,
#       TwoWriters the concurrency suites.
